Golfers Rahm, DeChambeau Face Scrutiny Amid LIV Golf Uncertainty

LIV Golf players Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau are facing scrutiny and uncertainty regarding their future participation in professional golf. Golfer Sam Burns expressed a desire to see Rahm and DeChambeau return to the PGA Tour. Meanwhile, DeChambeau referred to reporters as 'mafia' and removed a media member from a LIV Golf driving range. Rory McIlroy questioned the value Rahm and DeChambeau have brought to LIV Golf. DeChambeau is also reportedly making contingency plans due to the ongoing uncertainty surrounding LIV Golf.
